Hello Riley,

I noticed that Lumen Ledger is hiring a billing operations analyst. Teams adding billing headcount often also look at how much of the reconciliation work could be automated.

We reconcile invoices against payments automatically for small finance teams. Would a 15-minute call to compare notes be useful?

Best regards
